# vendored inference kernel — provenance and licence

This directory is **not** original code of this project. It is a byte-identical
copy of the headless inference modules from the neighbouring project
`D:\code\long_night_tools` ("长夜 · 对话推理"), plus a regenerated `blocks.js`.

| file | origin |
| --- | --- |
| `engine.js`, `messages.js`, `local.js`, `team.js`, `hypotheses.js`, `sound-candidates.js`, `route-explanations.js`, `advice.js`, `inference.js`, `inference-facts.js`, `example-search.js`, `journal.js`, `timeline.js` | copied verbatim from `long_night_tools/` |
| `blocks.js` | generated by `scripts/extract-blocks.py` from `D:\code\lgtbot\games\long_night\map.h`; format identical to the neighbour's extractor |
| `block-signatures.json` | colour signatures of all 71 blocks, sampled from images rendered by lgtbot's own `tool_block_exporter` + `markdown2image` (see `scripts/build-block-signatures.cjs`) |
| `LICENSE.lgtbot` | copied from `long_night_tools/LICENSE.lgtbot` |

Deliberately **not** vendored (browser-only or server entry points):
`worker.js`, `background.js`, `chat.js`, `workspace.js`, `recovery.js`,
`quick-input.js`, `server.cjs`.

## Updating

* kernel code: `npm run sync-vendor` (copies from `long_night_tools`, use
  `--from <dir>` if it lives elsewhere; `npm test` fails on drift).
* block data: `npm run extract-blocks [-- <games/long_night>]` — the extractor
  fails closed on unknown C++ setters, so a rules update can never silently
  produce wrong block data.
